$comment: The tables of a sceptre analysis folder. Both prototype libraries and both validators read this file. SPEC.md sections T0 to T6 are the rules; this file is their machine-readable form. A table's name is its path in the analysis folder, without `.parquet`.

descriptions.analysis: one analysis of a data file
descriptions.analysis.json: which data file this analysis belongs to, and which modality it tests
descriptions.record.json: the stage's settings and its list of files; written last, so a folder without one did not finish

stages.parameters: what the user asked to test
stages.qc: which cells and pairs passed quality control
stages.calibration: tests of negative-control pairs, which should find nothing
stages.power: tests of positive-control pairs, which should find their known effects

descriptions.fits: a cache of regression fits shared by the testing stages; not a stage, and deleting it changes no result
descriptions.part: the fits one job added; the file says inside how they were made

column_types.string: UTF-8 text, plain or dictionary-encoded; never missing
column_types.double: 64-bit float; may be missing where `nullable` is true
column_types.list<double>: a list of 64-bit floats per row

fields.description: what the table holds, in plain words
fields.stage: the stage that writes the table, which is also the folder it is in; null for the fit cache, which no stage owns
fields.required: whether the table must exist once its stage has run
fields.key: the key columns, in sort order; a key column that is not required is part of the key when it is present
fields.extra_columns: `ignored`: a reader takes only the columns listed. `kept`: a reader keeps further columns (diagnostics)
fields.log_2_of: a column that must equal the base-2 logarithm of another, computed as log(x) / log(2), to the relative tolerance given, wherever the table has both and neither is missing
fields.present_under: on a column: the gRNA integration strategies under which the column is present; under any other strategy it is absent
fields.forbidden_columns: columns the table must not have
fields.unique_across_parts: false where two part files may hold the same key (the fit cache); a reader then takes either row

tables.name: parameters/discovery_pairs
tables.description: the pairs to test, as the user gave them

tables.name: parameters/positive_control_pairs
tables.description: pairs with a known effect, as the user gave them

tables.name: assignment/assignments
tables.description: which gRNA is in which cell: one row per gRNA assigned to a cell

tables.name: assignment/flagged_cells
tables.description: cells the assignment method judges not to carry exactly one gRNA

tables.name: qc/cells
tables.description: every cell, and whether it passed quality control

tables.name: qc/discovery_pair_qc
tables.description: every discovery pair, and whether it passed quality control

tables.name: qc/positive_control_pair_qc
tables.description: every positive-control pair, and whether it passed quality control

tables.name: calibration/negative_control_groups
tables.description: the groups of non-targeting gRNAs tested as if they were targets

tables.name: calibration/results
tables.description: test results for the negative-control pairs

tables.name: power/results
tables.description: test results for the positive-control pairs

tables.name: discovery/results
tables.description: test results for the discovery pairs

tables.name: calibration/resamples
tables.description: the resampled test statistics behind the calibration results

tables.name: power/resamples
tables.description: the resampled test statistics behind the power results

tables.name: discovery/resamples
tables.description: the resampled test statistics behind the discovery results

tables.name: fits/response
tables.description: saved regression fits, one row per response

fits.$comment: A cache shared by the testing stages. Not listed in any stage record. The folder holds part files only. Each part says how its fits were made, as JSON text under `identity_key` in the Parquet file's key-value metadata, conforming to `identity_schema`. A reader uses a part only if that identity is its own. Cleared when the qc stage or an earlier one is rerun. `fits/grna` is reserved.
